entities.name: ord-2433120a65bd4af38166f7baaeba4e8b
observations: Exact ORD reaction converts CC(=O)OCCn1c(C)nc2c(Cl)nc3ccccc3c21 to Cc1nc2c(Cl)nc3ccccc3c2n1CCO.
The transformation removes an acetate group from a 2-acetoxyethyl substituent while retaining the heteroaromatic core, chlorine, methyl group, and N–CH2CH2 linkage.

entities.name: K2CO3 in methanol
observations: The matched reaction record uses potassium carbonate in methanol for acetate deprotection/methanolysis.
This condition is consistent with mild base-promoted O-deacetylation to a free alcohol.

entities.name: O-deacetylation
observations: The reaction class is base-promoted acetate ester deprotection, formally ester methanolysis or hydrolysis.
The acetate fragment is removed and the terminal oxygen becomes hydroxyl in the product.
